caption: The drawing depicts a painted wooden statue of a standing figure with medium brown skin, black hair, and three large brown feathers or plumes rising vertically from a yellow headband. The figure is dressed in a green tunic and an open, dark reddish-brown cloak that drapes over the left shoulder and covers most of the back and left arm. The lower legs are yellow, with a red band around the right thigh, and the figure wears green shoes with a band of yellow at the top. The statue stands on a rectangular dark brown plinth, which has four wheels at the corners and the words “TOBACCO CIGARS” painted in large yellow letters on its sides. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition is centered with the figure shown in right profile view. The artist’s signature, “Christ Makrenos,” is visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Cigar Store Indian
